messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Measurement ka matlab kisi quantity ko standard unit se compare karna hai. Length batate waqt sirf “5” kaafi nahi—5 metre ya 5 centimetre batana hota hai. Number measurement ka size batata hai; unit uska scale batati hai. Har reading mein value aur unit dono likho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Theek hai, isi baat par dhyan deta hoon.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: SI duniya bhar mein istemal hone wala standard unit system hai. Basic quantities ke units mein length—metre (m), mass—kilogram (kg), time—second (s), electric current—ampere (A), temperature—kelvin (K) shamil hain. Railway point: force SI mein newton (N), energy joule (J), power watt (W) hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, ab baat samajh mein aa rahi hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Derived unit base units ko multiply ya divide karke banta hai. Speed = distance/time, isliye unit m/s. Acceleration = speed/time, isliye m/s². Force = mass × acceleration, isliye kg·m/s², jise newton (N) kehte hain. Formula se unit nikalna yaad karne se zyada bharosemand hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Haan Sir, simple tareeke se samajh aa gaya.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Prefixes bahut bade ya chhote numbers ko aasaan banate hain: kilo = 1000, centi = 1/100, milli = 1/1000, micro = 10⁻⁶. Isliye 1 km = 1000 m aur 1 m = 100 cm. Conversion mein pehle prefix ka factor likho, phir number badlo.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, ab baat samajh mein aa rahi hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bahut bade/chhote number ko scientific notation mein a × 10ⁿ likhte hain, jahan 1 ≤ a < 10. Jaise 300000 = 3 × 10⁵ aur 0.0004 = 4 × 10⁻⁴. Advanced calculations mein powers of ten se multiplication/division aasaan hoti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Theek hai, pehle ye baat yaad rakhta hoon.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Scalar quantity mein sirf size hota hai—mass, time, temperature. Vector mein size ke saath direction bhi hoti hai—displacement, velocity, force. Daily example: “5 km” distance batata hai; “5 km east” direction bhi batata hai. Railway mein distance aur displacement ka farq poocha ja sakta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, abhi isi baat ko yaad karta hoon.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Accuracy ka matlab reading true value ke kitne paas hai; precision ka matlab baar-baar ki readings aapas mein kitni milti hain. Ek weighing machine har baar 2 kg zyada dikhaye to readings precise ho sakti hain, par accurate nahi. Har measurement mein instrument aur reading ka error ho sakta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Abhi ka main point clear hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Least count instrument ki sabse chhoti readable division hoti hai. Ruler ki divisions 1 mm ho to uski least count 1 mm hai. Chhoti least count se fine measurement mil sakti hai, lekin sahi reading ke liye instrument ko zero par check karna bhi zaroori hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Main pehle isi concept ko pakka karunga.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Dimensional formula batata hai ki quantity mass (M), length (L), time (T) jaise base quantities par kaise depend karti hai. Speed ka dimension LT⁻¹ aur force ka MLT⁻² hai. Equation ke dono sides ke dimensions milne chahiye; is test se galat formula pakda ja sakta hai, par sahi numerical constant prove nahi hota.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Main pehle isi concept ko pakka karunga.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Density = mass/volume. SI unit kg/m³ hai; chhote samples mein g/cm³ bhi use hota hai. Same volume ke iron aur sponge ka mass alag hota hai kyunki density alag hoti hai. Formula se unknown mass ya volume nikaal sakte ho, bas units ko pehle consistent banao.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Theek hai Sir, main is point ko yaad rakhoonga.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Random error readings ko kabhi thoda zyada, kabhi thoda kam kar sakta hai; repeated readings ka mean madad karta hai. Systematic error har reading ko ek hi taraf shift karta hai, jaise zero error. Instrument ko calibrate karna systematic error kam karta hai. Significant figures result ki justified precision dikhate hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, abhi isi baat ko yaad karta hoon.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Example: 72 km/h ko m/s mein badlo. 1 km = 1000 m aur 1 h = 3600 s, isliye 72 × 1000/3600 = 20 m/s. Shortcut: km/h ko m/s mein badalne ke liye 5/18 se multiply; m/s ko km/h mein badalne ke liye 18/5 se.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha, abhi isi baat ko yaad karta hoon.

quiz_payload.question: Electric current ka SI base unit kya hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Ampere electric current ka SI base unit hai. Volt potential difference, ohm resistance aur watt power ki unit hai.

quiz_payload.question: Force ki SI unit kaun si hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Force = mass × acceleration; SI base units kg·m/s² ko newton (N) kehte hain.

quiz_payload.question: 36 km/h barabar kitne m/s hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: km/h ko m/s mein badalne ke liye 5/18 se multiply: 36 × 5/18 = 10 m/s.

quiz_payload.question: Inmein se vector quantity kaunsi hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Force ka size aur direction dono hote hain, isliye force vector hai.

quiz_payload.question: Speed ka dimensional formula kya hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Speed = distance/time, isliye dimension L/T ya LT⁻¹ hota hai.

quiz_payload.question: Applied case 1: Train ki speed 72 km/h hai. Meters per second mein yeh kitni hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: 72 × 5/18 = 20 m/s. Unit conversion mein km ko m aur hour ko seconds mein badlo.

quiz_payload.question: Applied case 2: 2 kg trolley ko 3 m/s² acceleration milti hai. Net force kitna hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Newton ke second law se F = ma = 2 × 3 = 6 N.

quiz_payload.question: Applied case 3: Ek chhote block ka mass 200 g aur volume 100 cm³ hai. Density kya hogi?

revision_points.point: Length—m; mass—kg; time—s; current—A; temperature—K. Force—N; energy—J; power—W.
Prefixes ke powers of ten likhkar convert karo; km/h → m/s mein 5/18, reverse mein 18/5.
Accuracy true value se paas; precision repeated readings ki closeness; least count instrument ki smallest division.
Equation ke dono sides ke dimensions same hone chahiye; dimensional analysis numerical constant nahi batata.
